why.title: Honesty before promises
why.text: We don't guarantee the embassy's decision because no one can. We guarantee a complete file, free of errors.

why.title: One consultant for your file
why.text: One person who knows your story from start to finish, so questions aren't repeated and details aren't lost.

why.title: Full transparency
why.text: Embassy fees are separate from service fees, and every step is known to you in advance.

why.title: Expertise in the details
why.text: We know what each embassy looks for, and we prepare your file the way it prefers.

faq.q: Do you guarantee that I will get the visa?
faq.a: No one can guarantee an embassy's decision, and anyone who promises otherwise is not telling the truth. What we guarantee is a complete, well-organised file, free of the errors behind most refusals.

faq.q: How long is the first consultation, and is it free?
faq.a: Yes, the initial assessment is free and usually takes 15 minutes over WhatsApp or phone. We tell you honestly which visa type suits you and what your chances are.
faq._ar: كم تستغرق الاستشارة الأولى وهل هي مجانية؟

faq.q: What is the difference between embassy fees and service fees?
faq.a: Embassy fees are paid to the official authority, vary by country, and are outside our control. Our service fee covers consultation, preparation and follow-up, and is confirmed with you before we start.
faq._ar: ما الفرق بين رسوم السفارة ورسوم الخدمة؟

faq.q: My visa was refused before. Can you help?
faq.a: Yes. We start by analysing the reason for the previous refusal, fix the weak points in your file, and reapply with a different plan.
faq._ar: سبق أن رُفضت تأشيرتي، هل يمكنكم المساعدة؟

faq.q: Do I need to book flights and a hotel before applying?
faq.a: Most embassies only ask for a provisional booking. We provide suitable provisional bookings for your visa file without you paying the full ticket price.
faq._ar: هل أحتاج لحجز طيران وفندق قبل التقديم؟

faq.q: Do you serve clients outside Saudi Arabia?
faq.a: Yes, we serve clients from all Arab countries, citizens and residents alike, taking into account that requirements vary by nationality and country of residence.
faq._ar: هل تخدمون العملاء من خارج السعودية؟

faq.q: How do I track my application?
faq.a: Your consultant stays in touch with you on WhatsApp at every stage, from submission until you receive your passport.

faq.q: Are you a government body or an embassy?
faq.a: No. ELMAQSED is a licensed independent consultancy and does not represent any embassy or government body.
faq._ar: هل أنتم جهة حكومية أو سفارة؟

about.title: Every road is different… the destination is one
about.intro: ELMAQSED is a Saudi company specialising in travel visa consulting. We began with a simple observation: most refusals are not the applicant's fault, but the result of an incomplete file or an unclear story.
story: The name ELMAQSED means the destination we are heading to. That is why our logo is built from arrows coming from different directions and converging on a single point: the point of arrival.
Every client has a different path and circumstances, and our role is to help them reach the right destination through a clear, well-planned route, free of exaggerated promises.
We chose to be a calm, precise and responsible brand: no overused symbols, no false guarantees, and full transparency about fees and steps.
